PPM 90-2, nine (9) of the twenty-eight (28) buildings, for which existing L10 noise levels were measured, were greater than the PPM 90-2 L10 noise level standard of 70 dBA. The exterior L10 noise levels predicted for the twenty-eight (28) buildings in this Land Use Category yielded twenty-six (26) buildings with design year 1990 exterior L10 noise levels in the over 70 dBA range.
In addition, if consideration of PPM 90-2 Land Use Category "E" for interior L10 traffic generated design year noise levels is applied to the residential structures taking into account a noise (dBA) reduction factor from the predicted exterior L10 traffic generated noise level (based upon the climatic conditions characterizing the area and the existing and/or anticipated future structural condition of each building), the predicted interior traffic generated design year L10 noise levels for ten (10) of twenty-eight (28) sites subject to this Land Use Category are higher than the design year interior L10 noise level standard of 55 dBA contained in PPM 90-2.
Exception to the design year noise level thresholds of PPM 90-2 will be needed for all structures or buildings subject to Land Use Category "B", Land Use Category "C" and Land Use Category "E" developed land uses adjacent to the proposed improvement.
The reasons for requesting exception to the respective design year noise level thresholds (70 dBA exterior for Land Use Category "B", 75 dBA exterior for Land Use Category "C" and 55 dBA interior for Land Use Category "E") are:
    The ability to acquire additional right-of-way as buffer zones and the possibility of altering roadway grades is limited due to the location of the roads, development within the area, and topography.
Buffer zones would require the removal of existing residential and commercial structures resulting in a severe economic and social adverse effect on the communities and Townships in Cook County involved with this improvement, as well as producing adverse effects upon individual residents, owners, and employees that would be displaced.
